text: Pre-existing credential leak (surfaced by 059-S security review, P2): _execute_single_source in src/docline/elt/execute.py logs the raw source_key ('web_crawl:<url>' carrying the query token, plus partially-sanitized userinfo) at ERROR via _log.exception. sanitize_source() is a no-op on the 'web_crawl:' prefix, so both metadata.source (persisted metadata.json) and the ERROR log leak URL-carried query credentials. The 059-S WARNING payload (origin-only) is clean; this is the adjacent ERROR/persistence path. Fix requires sanitizing the URL inside the source_key WITHOUT changing job_id determinism (job_id is a hash of source_key), and updating tests/elt/test_elt_real_execution.py::test_url_fetch_failure_logs_source_key_and_job_id which asserts metadata.source appears in the message. Pre-existing on origin/main; out of scope for 059-S. Do not bundle with shipment 060-S.

TOOLING: Fix Playwright MCP server browser default. The configured 'playwright' MCP server defaults to Chrome at the standard per-user install path (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe) which is NOT installed in this environment, so it fails at launch. Microsoft Edge IS installed at the standard system path (%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe). Validated working override 2026-09-08 (read-only probe of registry.terraform.io): @playwright/mcp with args --browser msedge --headless. Recommend updating .mcp.json playwright server to prefer msedge or add an Edge-backed fallback server (optionally driven by an env-configurable browser channel/executable path rather than a hardcoded location). Tooling/infra only, NOT a docline runtime dependency (feature 070-F / shipment 061-S is browserless, API-based; tests use recorded fixtures). Do NOT bundle with 061-S. Recorded per operator directive (capture MCP config change as a task, do not edit .mcp.json during Stage).
